doc.title: Donn Andre interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, June 6, 2009

title: What Hamilton gave him
summary: Independence and perseverance, plus running a band as a business apprenticeship.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: Is there something you got from Hamilton that you can put into words that really made a difference for you in your career?

I think the thing that strikes me most is a feeling of, one independence, and two being able to accomplish something. Yeah, it was the perseverance aspect. And part of that was the college itself and part of it due to professors really pushing you to do well, and appreciating it, and telling you so if you did well. And the other aspect of course was being involved with a jazz band and booking gigs and making arrangements and all of that, which is kind of like running a business. And I was not a businessman. I went into the federal government. You don’t have to be a businessman to be in the federal government.
